youtube.title: Why Water Bottles Glug When You Pour 💧 #Shorts #science #facts #didyouknow
youtube.description:
When you flip a full bottle with a narrow neck, water and air must pass through the same small opening. Water cannot flow out until air bubbles in to replace it, so the flow starts and stops and makes the glug sound. A wide glass has room for both to move at once. Tilting the bottle lets air enter along one side for a smooth pour.
